g.text: py-app-panel-campagne-hofplein | type panel | trim 600 x 840 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 22 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: InfoPylonBordGoed.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 600 x 840 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 606 x 846 mm.

Variabelen: background-colour = #1A3580; price = €7; price-decimals = ,50; unit = per dag; footnote-mark = *; url-line-1 = voordelig; url-line-2 = parkeren.nl; headline-1 = Midden; headline-2 = in de stad; headline-3-keyword = parkeren; headline-3-punctuation = ,; headline-4 = voor een; headline-5-keyword = prikkie; location-line-1 = Parking

Navy field 600 x 714.3 mm (runs 3 mm into the bleed at top, left and right), the lower 125.7 mm is white paper (no ink) with the garage lockup. The white price circle is a hole in the navy field in the source (paper shows through); the template draws it as a white shape. Reference keeps all outlines as extracted paths (headline, url, per dag, name); only

the price is live text, rotated 21.8 degrees. Template: headline, url, price, unit and name are live Ubuntu text with data-variable. OPEN POINT (copy): the asterisk after per dag has no footnote anywhere on the panel; kept as in the source (variable footnote-mark). OPEN POINT (copy): the URL is split inside the domain (voordelig / parkeren.nl), kept as

in the source. Fitted fonts (measured by overlay with the outlines): headline Ubuntu Regular/Bold 106.25 mm, URL line 1 Bold 37.7 mm, URL line 2 Light 34.4 mm, per dag upright Regular 34.17 mm, name Bold 46.7 mm.
